content_data.email_purpose: Proposing architectural changes to support network traffic scaling and improve system reliability across regional telecommunications infrastructure.
key_points: Current monolithic architecture experiencing performance degradation during peak traffic periods
Estimated timeline of 14 months with phased rollout to minimize service disruption
Adoption of event-driven architecture for real-time network monitoring and alerts
Implementation of distributed caching layer to reduce database load by estimated 40%
Proposed microservices migration to enable horizontal scaling and fault isolation
content_data.call_to_action: Please review the attached technical proposal and provide feedback within the next 10 days so we can schedule an architecture review meeting.
